## Publish gate report

**Going out:** landing page hero, UK audience, Pebblebrook Tea Co.

**Checks**
- **Claims:**
  - "Pause or cancel any time" is on the policy list.
  - "Free UK delivery on orders over £25" is on the policy list.
  - "Means most boxes ship free" is **unproven**. The policy backs the £25 threshold, but nothing shows that most orders reach it. It's an implied statistic about order values.
- **Regulated claims:** it touches prices and offers. The free-delivery condition (over £25) is stated, so it's fine. The "most boxes ship free" line is the only problem.
- **House style:** reads plainly, with no banned words or AI tells. "Easy to stop and start" is backed by the pause/cancel claim.
- **Disclosure:** the brand's own page, so no label is needed.

**Fixed:** nothing applied yet. I'm waiting on your call on the one change below.

**Needs a decision**
- Remove "means most boxes ship free". Suggested copy:
  > Tea that's easy to stop and start. Subscribers can pause or cancel any time, and delivery is free in the UK on orders over £25.
- If you do have order data showing most boxes exceed £25, share the source and date. I can then add it to the policy and keep the line.

**Approver:** the policy names no approver, so I need an explicit yes from you on the exact final copy. I haven't recorded any approval, and nothing should publish until the revised text is confirmed.
